increment
column2: and the MDS will drop certain types of requests on the floor

column1: when the sequence numbers don't match.
In particular
column2: a REQUEST_CLOSE message can cross with one of the

column1: sequence morphing messages from the MDS which can cause the client to
stall
column2: waiting for a response that will never come.

column1: Originally
column2: this meant an up to 5s delay before the recurring workqueue

column1: job kicked in and resent the request
column2: but a recent change made it so

column1: that the client would never resend
sometimes a blockisting event.
Add a new helper for incrementing the session sequence and then testing
to see whether a REQUEST_CLOSE needs to be resent
of CEPH_MDS_SESSION_CLOSING into that function. Change all of the
bare sequence counter increments to use the new helper.
Reorganize check_session_state with a switch statement.  It should no
